scheme_name: Empower ST/SC Communities using ICT Tools through IT Knowledge Centre (ITKC)
description:
The Empower ST/SC Communities using ICT Tools through IT Knowledge Centre (ITKC) scheme was launched by the Government of India in 2016. 

This initiative aims to bridge the digital divide among Scheduled Tribes (ST) and Scheduled Castes (SC) communities. 

The scheme is part of the broader Digital India initiative which was launched on July 1, 2015. 

The primary objective of the ITKC scheme is to enhance the digital literacy and skill set of ST and SC communities. 

The scheme aims to establish a network of IT Knowledge Centres across various states in India. 

The target is to set up 1,000 IT Knowledge Centres by the end of 2025. 

These centres are designed to provide training in Information and Communication Technology (ICT) tools. 

The goal is to empower these communities to access information and services online. 

The ITKC scheme also aims to promote entrepreneurship among ST and SC individuals. 

By providing them with the necessary skills, the scheme seeks to increase their employability in the digital economy. 

The benefits of the ITKC scheme include free training in various ICT-related skills. 

Participants will receive training in basic computer operations, internet usage, and software applications. 

The training programs are designed to be inclusive and accessible to all eligible participants. 

Each IT Knowledge Centre is expected to train at least 500 individuals annually. 

The scheme also provides for the establishment of a digital platform for resource sharing. 

This platform will facilitate access to educational materials and online courses. 

The eligibility criteria for the ITKC scheme include being a member of a Scheduled Tribe or Scheduled Caste. 

Participants must be between the ages of 15 and 45 years. 

There are no specific educational qualifications required for participation. 

However, a basic understanding of reading and writing is beneficial. 

The application process for the ITKC scheme involves several steps. 

Interested individuals must approach their nearest IT Knowledge Centre. 

They need to fill out an application form that is available at the centre. 

The form requires basic personal information such as name, age, and community details. 

Applicants must also provide proof of their ST or SC status. 

This can be done by submitting a caste certificate issued by a competent authority. 

Once the application is submitted, the centre will conduct an assessment to determine eligibility. 

Successful applicants will be enrolled in the training programs. 

The training sessions are typically conducted over a period of three months. 

Participants will receive a certificate upon successful completion of the training. 

The disbursement of benefits under the scheme occurs at the end of the training period. 

Each participant may receive a stipend of INR 1,500 for the duration of the training. 

This stipend is intended to cover transportation and other incidental expenses. 

The ITKC scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology. 

The National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology (NIELIT) is the primary agency responsible for execution. 

NIELIT operates under the Ministry and provides technical support and training materials. 

The scheme also collaborates with various state governments to ensure effective implementation. 

Each state government is responsible for identifying suitable locations for the IT Knowledge Centres. 

The centres are typically set up in rural and semi-urban areas to maximize outreach. 

As of October 2023, approximately 300 IT Knowledge Centres have been established across India. 

These centres have collectively trained over 50,000 individuals since the scheme's inception. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from participants who report improved job prospects. 

Many graduates of the program have successfully started their own businesses. 

The ITKC scheme also emphasizes the importance of digital literacy in today’s economy. 

It aims to reduce the digital gap between urban and rural populations. 

The initiative is expected to contribute significantly to the socio-economic development of ST and SC communities. 

The government has allocated a budget of INR 200 crores for the implementation of the ITKC scheme over five years. 

This funding is aimed at infrastructure development and training program costs. 

The scheme is part of a larger effort to promote inclusivity in the digital age. 

The government recognizes that access to technology is essential for empowerment. 

The ITKC scheme is a step towards ensuring that marginalized communities are not left behind. 

The scheme also aligns with the Sustainable Development Goals set by the United Nations. 

It specifically targets Goal 4 which aims to ensure inclusive and equitable quality education. 

The ITKC initiative is expected to create a sustainable model for digital education. 

It encourages community participation in the learning process. 

Local youth are often trained as instructors to facilitate knowledge transfer. 

This approach not only empowers the learners but also creates job opportunities for trainers. 

The ITKC scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to social equity. 

It reflects a proactive approach to addressing the challenges faced by ST and SC communities. 

The scheme is continuously monitored and evaluated for its effectiveness. 

Feedback from participants is regularly collected to improve training methodologies. 

The government aims to expand the reach of the ITKC scheme in the coming years. 

Plans are underway to integrate more advanced ICT training modules. 

This includes training in areas such as coding, digital marketing, and e-commerce. 

The ITKC scheme is an essential component of India's strategy to build a knowledge-based economy. 

It seeks to empower individuals with the skills necessary to thrive in a digital world. 

The initiative is a crucial step towards achieving economic self-sufficiency for marginalized communities. 

Through the ITKC scheme, the government aims to create a more inclusive society. 

This initiative underscores the importance of technology in fostering social change. 

The ITKC scheme is a significant move towards ensuring that every citizen has the opportunity to succeed in the digital era.
